purpose: Meaning-preservation and register evaluation; not authorship detection or author impersonation.

split.instructions: Freeze profile and engine rules before running. Do not tune them against these texts or test feedback. Replace holdouts before a future rule revision.
limitations: The curator necessarily inspected evaluation excerpts.
Author overlap exists with other works in analysis.
No claim of exclusion from a model’s historical pretraining.
Two short excerpts provide bounded checks, not a statistically representative writing benchmark.

scoring.automatic: Only provenance, hash, word-count and split validation can be automatic. No lexical score establishes writing quality.

scale.1: partly satisfies; reviewer explains remaining defect

scoring.hard_failure: Any unsupported claim, changed uncertainty, changed mechanism or invented experience.
scoring.reporting: Keep original, revision, reviewer notes and dimension scores. Report failures and do not present a proposed protocol as a completed result.

benchmarks.excerpt: Desire to share an experience which one feels is valuable and ought not to be missed.
benchmarks.task: Turn this fragment into one clear complete sentence for a general reader. Preserve its subjective evaluation; do not add an autobiographical event.
review_checks: The wish to share an experience remains.
Value remains a person’s judgment, not an established universal fact.
No invented experience, identity or motivation.
Complete sentence is readable and preserves the original relation.
failure_examples_described: Adds a personal story that was not supplied.
Changes subjective value into an objective claim.
benchmarks.curator_access: Excerpt and location inspected solely for source verification and evaluation curation.
benchmarks.authorship_evidence: Publicly attributed author prose on institution/estate-permitted site; not forensic authorship proof.

benchmarks.locator: Section I.b, Nano Technology, sentence beginning It is hoped
benchmarks.excerpt: It is hoped that such materials could revolutionize electronic design and open the space frontier by radically lowering the cost of launch to orbit.
benchmarks.task: Revise this sentence for a formal research briefing. Keep its tentative status and the claimed mechanism. Do not claim an achieved result or introduce a numerical saving.
review_checks: The proposed mechanism is a lower cost of launch to orbit.
No unsupported quantitative effect or achieved-outcome claim.
No conversion of historical aspiration into a current fact.
failure_examples_described: Turns could into will or has.
benchmarks.curator_access: Excerpt and location inspected solely for source verification and evaluation curation.
benchmarks.authorship_evidence: Publicly attributed author prose on institution/estate-permitted site; not forensic authorship proof.
